title: Understanding Linear Independence
text: Linear independence of columns in a design matrix ensures that no column can be expressed as a linear combination of the others. This is crucial for the uniqueness of the OLS solution.

title: Number of Observations vs. Parameters
text: In this problem, you have $$30$$ observations and $$30$$ parameters (including the intercept). Consider how this affects the linear independence of the design matrix columns.

hintAnswer: The columns are linearly independent if the rank of the matrix is $$30$$.
title: Checking for Linear Independence
text: Given that there are $$30$$ observations and $$30$$ parameters, what can you infer about the linear independence of the design matrix columns?

title: OLS Solution Uniqueness
text: The OLS solution is unique if the design matrix has full column rank, meaning all columns are linearly independent.

title: Conclusion on OLS Solution
text: Based on the linear independence of the design matrix columns, what can you conclude about the uniqueness of the OLS solution?
